verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch offers a documented CLI for running tests/collections from the terminal and an official MCP server that lets an agent read and modify collections, requests, environments, and teams, giving substantial programmatic access. However, there is no evidence of a full public REST/GraphQL API mirroring all UI capabilities—probes for an OpenAPI/swagger spec all returned 404—so parity with the UI is incomplete. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose API (OpenAPI/GraphQL) covering all UI features, evidence of feature-parity between CLI/MCP and UI (e.g. environment management, sharing, collaboration features), and independent confirmation that these interfaces cover 100% of UI functionality.
